integrity: The theorem is established by a direct case split, absolute irreducibility of rank-one isotropic Segre cones, and an additive-character count. The finite-field checker independently evaluates original multiplication. No independent review has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only nondegenerate symmetric bilinear forms in vector dimensions n>=2 and char(k)!=2. The geometry describes the reduced zero-product variety, not the possibly nonreduced defining scheme. Counts are ordered pairs, not orbits. Publication priority remains provisional.
title: Four components of the zero-product variety of a spin-factor Jordan algebra
